claim: For the two-qubit XY Hamiltonian with a \(z\)-directed Dzyaloshinskii--Moriya interaction and uniform field studied by Qin, Xu, Tao, and Tian, put \(K=\sqrt{J^2+D^2}\), \(G=|J\gamma|\), \(\Delta_B=\sqrt{B^2+G^2}\), and assume \(0<G<K\), \(B\ge0\), \(T>0\), \(\beta=1/T\). Define \[q_B(\beta)=\cosh^2(K\beta)-\frac{G^2}{\Delta_B^2}\sinh^2(\Delta_B\beta).\] The exact concurrence from the source is positive if and only if \(q_B(\beta)>2\) or \(q_B(\beta)<0\); hence it vanishes exactly when \(0\le q_B(\beta)\le2\). Let \(B_0=\sqrt{K^2-G^2}\). For \(0\le B\le B_0\), \(q_B\) is strictly increasing and there is one thermal threshold, the unique solution of \(q_B(\beta)=2\). For \(B>B_0\), \(q_B\) has one strict maximum. There is a unique \(B_*>B_0\) at which this maximum equals \(2\). If \(B_0<B<B_*\), there are \(0<\beta_1<\beta_2<\beta_3\) with \(q_B(\beta_1)=q_B(\beta_2)=2\) and \(q_B(\beta_3)=0\); the state is entangled for \(\beta_1<\beta<\beta_2\) and for \(\beta>\beta_3\), producing a genuine temperature-induced entanglement island separated from the low-temperature branch. If \(B\ge B_*\), only the low-temperature branch remains, beginning at the unique root of \(q_B=0\) (at \(B=B_*\) the level \(q=2\) is only tangent). As \(B\to\infty\), the critical inverse temperature satisfies \[\beta_c(B)=\frac{\log(2\Delta_B/G)+o(1)}{\Delta_B},\]so \(T_c(B)\sim B/\log(2B/G)\to\infty\). Thus the source's statement, made for \(J=1,\gamma=0.6,D=0.5\), that the critical temperature is independent of \(B\) is false. For those parameters \(B_0=0.9433981132\ldots\) and \(B_*=1.7495575302\ldots\). When \(G=0\), in contrast, the field really drops out and \(T_c=K/\log(1+\sqrt2)\).

integrity.computational_dependence: none for the theorem; the packaged checker is supplementary
integrity.novelty_scope: Exact scalar separability criterion and complete homogeneous-field thermal crossing topology for the 2008 XY-DM model, including the unique B-star and high-field asymptotic correcting the source's field-independence statement.
integrity.ownership_basis: The result is a quantum-entanglement classification. Mathematical bibliographic records for the same two-qubit DM-entanglement model family list Quantum coherence, entanglement, quantum correlations (81P40) as the primary MSC.
integrity.source_date_basis: The article is recorded as published on 2008-08-01 in volume 17 issue 8; no earlier public preprint was located.

scientific_limitations: The exact phase classification assumes 0<|J gamma|<sqrt(J^2+D^2); the degenerate endpoint is not classified.
The result concerns two-qubit Gibbs-state concurrence and is not an infinite-volume thermodynamic phase-transition theorem.
The high-field asymptotic refers to the low-temperature entangled-branch threshold.

Earlier DM-free anisotropic XY work already establishes magnetic-field-dependent critical temperature; originality is limited to the exact XY-DM scalar reduction, complete crossing topology, unique island-annihilation field, and correction of the 2008 claim.
title: Corrected magnetic-field phase diagram for the anisotropic XY–DM thermal concurrence
